reply.text:
Electrolytes make sense in a few situations: long or very sweaty sessions, hot conditions, or runs and rides past an hour or so. For most lifting sessions, water and normal meals cover it. I can't give you an amount of sodium, though. That depends on how much you sweat, what you eat, and your health, so a doctor or registered dietitian is the right person for that number.

If you tell me what your sessions look like (length, how hot, how much you sweat), I can talk through whether it's even worth worrying about for your training.
